text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O gets injured during training, so I quickly bring her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for causing you all this trouble. I feel a lot better now that I've been treated.
choice_data_list: For now, you need to rest up and recover.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um… Are you sure it's okay for me to rest?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: When my dad was a sumo wrestler, he kept on training even when he was injured. Slowly and carefully, of course.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I believe it's important to work hard day after day. That's what gives you the strength to withstand any adversity.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So, please! I want to continue with my training! I won't push myself too hard, and I'll make sure to go slowly!
choice_data_list: It's too dangerous with that injury.
Okay. Let's see what you can do.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I wasn't thinking clearly. You're right. I could make my injury worse if I'm not careful.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll go rest so I can heal properly and get back to training as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O looks crestfallen as she returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you so much! Let's go straight to the gym!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Owww! It hurts just to walk…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I suppose this means I can't just prioritize my feelings—I need to think about my body as well…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If this injury worsens, all my hard work will have been for nothing… I think I'll rest for today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O looks frustrated as she slowly returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'll make sure I don't overdo it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I just tried some stretches, and it went much better than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Next, I'd like to try some exercises that don't put any strain on my injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O stays mindful of her injury and only does what she's capable of during training.
